title: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies - Business Studies - Introduction to Business Studies
exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The subject which provides basic knowledge and skills for business operations and self-reliance is called
questions.explain: Business Studies is an overarching subject taught at the junior secondary level to provide basic knowledge and skills in business operations.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a component of Business Studies?
questions.explain: The core components of Business Studies according to the syllabus are Office Practice, Commerce, Book-keeping, and Keyboarding/Computer. Civic Education is an entirely different subject.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The systematic recording of day-to-day financial transactions of a business is handled by which component of Business Studies?
questions.explain: Book-keeping is the specific component that deals with the regular, systematic recording of financial transactions (money received and paid out) in a business.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The component of Business Studies that deals with the buying, selling, and distribution of goods and services is
questions.explain: Commerce encompasses trade (buying and selling) and all activities that aid trade, such as transportation, insurance, and banking.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A student who excels in the keyboarding and computer component of Business Studies is most likely to pursue a career as a
questions.explain: Keyboarding equips a student with the typing skills necessary for secretarial duties, making Secretary or Typist the most direct career path from this component.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: One of the main reasons for studying Business Studies in Junior Secondary School is to
options: Prepare students for careers in the sciences
Equip students with basic entrepreneurial skills
Teach students how to repair heavy machinery
questions.explain: A primary importance of Business Studies is to build a foundation for self-employment and equip students with basic entrepreneurial skills.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which aspect of Business Studies provides knowledge on how to receive visitors and file documents properly?
questions.explain: Office Practice is the component that focuses on the daily administrative and clerical duties required to run an office smoothly, such as filing and receiving visitors.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are career opportunities available to someone who studied Business Studies EXCEPT
questions.explain: Accounting, Banking, and Office Management are direct career opportunities branching from Business Studies. Architecture relates more to technical drawing, engineering, and the arts.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The knowledge of Business Studies is beneficial to the society because it
options: Increases the rate of school dropouts
Promotes the production of goods and wealth creation
Encourages students to depend entirely on the government for jobs
questions.explain: Business Studies helps individuals start businesses, create jobs, and understand the economy, which collectively promotes wealth creation and production in society.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which combination best represents the inter-related components of Business Studies?
options: Office Practice, Commerce, Book-keeping, and Keyboarding
Office Practice, Law, Book-keeping, and Commerce
questions.explain: The four components outlined in the junior secondary syllabus are Office Practice, Commerce, Book-keeping, and Keyboarding/Computer.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A person who sets up a business, takes on financial risks, and hopes to make a profit is a(n)
questions.explain: An entrepreneur is someone who starts and runs a business, taking on financial risks with the goal of earning profit. Becoming an entrepreneur is a major career opportunity encouraged by Business Studies.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An understanding of Book-keeping is primarily important because it helps a business owner to
options: Determine if the business is making a profit or loss
Type letters at a very fast speed
Transport goods from the factory to the consumer
Design the structure of the office building
questions.explain: The fundamental purpose of keeping systematic financial records through Book-keeping is to assess the financial health of the enterprise, specifically whether it is making a profit or a loss.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The skills acquired from learning Keyboarding and Computer in Business Studies are crucial for
options: Electronic data processing and document preparation
questions.explain: Keyboarding/Computer skills are primarily used in the modern office for electronic data processing and document preparation, such as typing letters, memos, and handling emails.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A career path that specifically involves the selling of manufactured goods to the final consumer is an offshoot of which Business Studies component?
questions.explain: Retailing and selling goods falls under trade, which is the central core of Commerce. A career in retail or sales is therefore directly tied to the Commerce component.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Business Studies contributes to national development by teaching students how to
options: Avoid paying appropriate taxes to the government
Become responsible consumers and wealth creators
questions.explain: One of the broad importances of Business Studies is equipping citizens with the right attitudes toward work, consumption, and enterprise, helping them become responsible consumers and wealth creators.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Introduction to Business Studies
questions.subject: Business Studies
